entities.name: Hafþór Júlíus Björnsson
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hafþór Júlíus Björnsson is an Icelandic professional strongman. With 32 international titles, 60 total wins, 87 podiums, and 129 world records, he is the most prolific record breaker in the history of strength sports; he is widely regarded as one of the greatest and most decorated strength athletes of all time.
